label: The T schema of the route's NECESSARY_2 box entails a KT route frame
description: If the T schema of the route's box is valid on the route's modal frame, the frame is reflexive (KT). Applies the verified premise-free theorem TruthCore.Results.Modal.StandardCorrespondenceCertificate.certificate (the T correspondence) to the route frame. Establishes neither premise. No transcription is declared: the proof applies a proved correspondence theorem, not an open bridge.
